name: Chickpea Spinach Curry
ingredients: 1 tsp coriander powder, ¼ tsp turmeric, ½ tsp chilli powder
steps: Heat the oil, crackle the cumin, and cook the onion for 5 minutes. Add ginger and garlic.
Add the tomatoes and spices and cook for 6 minutes.
Add the spinach and cook until wilted, about 3 minutes.
Add the chickpeas and ½ cup water and simmer for 8 minutes, mashing a few to thicken.
Finish with garam masala, lemon juice and salt.
note: A quick weeknight curry using canned or pre-cooked chickpeas.
